notes: Values in NIS million as printed (the IFRS 17 notes of the listed parent are in NIS million). Columns of the long-term-savings segment table: total | life insurance | investment contracts | pension | provident; the investment-contract column is used.
The insurer (מגדל חברה לביטוח) is consolidated in מגדל אחזקות ביטוח ופיננסים; the segment note is at group level, and investment contracts are sold only by the insurer.
Quarter-end liabilities for yield-dependent investment contracts are taken from the interim balance sheet at every date it prints (current date, same date a year earlier, last year-end).

The directors' report footnote (p.88 of the PDF) rounds investment-contract receipts to NIS 4,784 million (2025) and 3,208 million (2024); the table in note 4 (p.198) prints 4,782 and 3,209; the table figures are used.
